name: Pale Malt (2-Row)
description: Base malt for most American ales and lagers. Clean, slightly sweet.

name: Pale Malt (Maris Otter)
description: Classic British base malt. Rich, biscuity character.

name: Pilsner Malt
description: Very light base malt for lagers and Belgian ales. Crisp and clean.

name: Vienna Malt
description: Lightly kilned malt with toasty, bready character. Commonly used in Vienna lagers and Märzens.

name: Munich Malt (Light)
description: Adds rich malty sweetness and amber color. Great in Märzens and dark lagers.

name: Munich Malt (Dark)
description: Deeply toasty, bread crust character. Used in Dunkel and Bock beers.

name: Wheat Malt
description: Adds haze, body, and a soft wheat flavor. Essential for Weizens and Witbiers.

name: Rye Malt
description: Spicy, dry character. Adds complexity to IPAs and rye ales.

name: Oat Malt
description: Adds creamy mouthfeel and silky body. Common in Oat IPAs and stouts.

name: Crystal 10L
description: Very light crystal malt. Subtle sweetness with little color impact.

name: Crystal 40L
description: Light crystal malt. Caramel sweetness, light amber color.

name: Crystal 60L
description: Medium crystal malt. Rich caramel flavor, golden-amber color.

name: Crystal 80L
description: Dark crystal malt. Toffee, raisin notes with amber-red color.

name: Crystal 120L
description: Very dark crystal. Dried fruit, burnt sugar notes. Deep red color.

name: Carapils (Dextrine)
description: Improves head retention and body without adding color or flavor.

name: Caramunich I
description: German caramel malt. Rich toffee and plum notes. Used in Märzens and Bocks.

name: Caramunich III
description: Deeply kilned German caramel. Dark fruit, caramel, slight chocolate note.

name: Melanoidin Malt
description: Adds deep malt complexity and reddish hue. Mimics decoction character.

name: Chocolate Malt
description: Dark roasted malt. Strong chocolate and coffee character with dry finish.

name: Pale Chocolate Malt
description: Mild chocolate and nutty character. Less harsh than full chocolate malt.

name: Roasted Barley
description: Unmalted roasted barley. Sharp coffee and dry roast. Essential for Dry Stout.

name: Black Patent Malt
description: Extremely dark malt. Acrid roast character. Use sparingly for color and bite.

name: Special B
description: Belgian dark crystal. Raisin, fig, and dark candy sugar notes. Key in Dubbels.

name: Aromatic Malt
description: Belgian malt with intense malty aroma. Amplifies base malt character.

name: Biscuit Malt
description: Warm biscuit and toasted bread notes. Great in English ales and Belgians.

name: Victory Malt
description: Toasted, nutty character. Good for adding complexity without significant color.

name: Honey Malt
description: Grainy sweetness and honey character. Accentuates hop aroma.

name: Smoked Malt (Beechwood)
description: German beechwood-smoked malt. Classic smoky character for Rauchbier.

name: Peated Malt
description: Heavily peated malt. Intense smoky phenolics. Use sparingly (10–15%).

name: Flaked Barley
description: Adds body, creaminess, and haze. Used in stouts and session ales.

name: Flaked Oats
description: Silky mouthfeel and haze. Key ingredient in Oat IPAs and Milk Stouts.

name: Flaked Wheat
description: Haze and body without husky flavor. Common in Witbiers.

name: Flaked Corn (Maize)
description: Light, clean fermentables. Dries out the beer and lightens body.

name: Flaked Rice
description: Very clean adjunct. Used in light American lagers for crisp dryness.

name: Torrified Wheat
description: Puffed wheat for improved head retention and haze.

name: Acidulated Malt (Sauermalz)
description: Lowers mash pH. Useful for pale styles and soft-water breweries.

name: Sugar (Table / Sucrose)
description: Ferments 100%. Dries out the beer and boosts ABV without body.

name: Candi Sugar (Clear)
description: Belgian invert sugar. Dry, clean fermentation boost used in Belgian strong ales.

name: Candi Sugar (Dark)
description: Dark Belgian invert sugar. Rich rum, toffee, and dark fruit notes for Dubbels and Tripels.

name: Lactose (Milk Sugar)
description: Unfermentable sugar. Adds sweetness and body. Essential for Milk Stouts.

name: Honey
description: Floral sweetness pre-fermentation, dry floral finish after. Used in Meads and Braggots.

name: Molasses
description: Dark, complex fermentable. Robust, slightly bitter sweetness. Used in porters and stouts.

name: Pale Ale Malt
description: Slightly more kilned than 2-row. Adds light biscuit and malt complexity to British ales.

name: Golden Promise
description: Scottish base malt. Clean, slightly sweet with good enzyme activity.

name: Carafoam
description: Head retention and body enhancement with minimal flavor contribution.

name: Cara-Hell
description: Very light German caramel malt. Gentle sweetness, excellent head retention.

name: Carafa Special II
description: Dehusked black malt. Dark color and roast flavor without harsh astringency.

name: Carafa Special III
description: Very dark dehusked malt. Coffee and dark chocolate without acrid bite.

name: Brown Malt
description: Traditional British malt with dry, coffee-like roast. Used in Porters and Brown Ales.

name: Amber Malt
description: Biscuity, toasty character. Historical ingredient for Porter and Brown Ale.
